chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: The time for the Salat of the eclipse is during the hour in which it eclipses, at the rising of the sun and at its setting.
And Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: It is Obligatory.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and timing for the eclipse prayer in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes Salat al-Kusuf as a Fard (obligatory) act, with Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifying that its timing is strictly bound to the duration of the eclipse, whether at sunrise or sunset. This ruling distinguishes it from other voluntary prayers and underscores the eclipse as a specific divine sign (Ayah) calling for immediate reflection and worship, a practice deeply rooted in the Sunnah of the Prophet and the Imams.
